---
title: "Recently Updated"
subtitle: "Every note, newest change first — the wiki's change log."
listing:
  contents:
    - "**/*.qmd"
    - "!**/index.qmd"
    - "!**/template.qmd"
    - "!recent.qmd"
  type: table
  sort: "date-modified desc"
  categories: true
  filter-ui: [title, categories]
  sort-ui: [title, date-modified]
  fields: [date-modified, title, categories]
  field-display-names:
    date-modified: "Updated"
  date-format: "YYYY-MM-DD"
draft: false
---

Each note's **Updated** date comes from its `date-modified` field.
Use the search box above, or follow the **Linked from** list at the bottom of any note to see what builds on it.
